mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates a restrictive monetary policy that compresses equity valuation multiples through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Weak industrial production (INDPRO < 110) signals reduced manufacturing output that lowers corporate capital expenditure and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained inflation above CPIAUCSL 207 indicates delayed central bank rate cuts that compress equity multiples, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 207.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1500 thousand units signals construction sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment decline (PAYEMS) and unemployment rise (UNRATE) signal acute labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 115) signals robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 115.
